  DiagramShape (packages/module-diagrams/src/shape.ts)
    export type DiagramShape = DiagramShapeBase & ({
        shape: "line";
        x1: number;
        y1: number;
        x2: number;
        y2: number;
    } | {
        shape: "rect";
        radius?: number;
    } | {
        shape: "circle";
        cx: number;
        cy: number;
        radius: number;
    } | {
        shape: "polygon";
        points: Array<{
            x: number;
            y: number;
        }>;
    } | {
        shape: "path";
        d: string;
    } | {
        shape: "text";
        text: string;
        textRole: DiagramTypeRole | "note";
        align?: "start" | "middle" | "end";
        fontSize?: number;
        fontWeight?: 400 | 500 | 600;
    });
